# American University Library

> American University Library provides comprehensive information about library services, hours, events, and digital resources for the AU community.

The American University Library system includes multiple locations such as Bender Library, Music Library, and Archives and Special Collections. The library offers events like Katzen Soundbites, online resource access including newspapers, and integrated calendar and scheduling tools for the university community.

## Key Topics

- Bender Library
- Music Library
- Archives and Special Collections
- Library Hours
- Katzen Soundbites
- Online Newspaper Access
- Library Events
- iCal Subscription
- Library Services
- American University
- Anderson Computing Complex
- Makerspace
- Canvas Integration
- Event Calendar
- OIT Support
